name: bug
description: Observed behavior differs from the intended design

name: enhancement
description: A new user- or system-visible capability

name: duplicate
description: Already tracked elsewhere; link the original before closing

name: good first issue
description: Self-contained and documented well enough for a first contribution

name: question
description: Belongs in Discussions; convert instead of answering here

name: wontfix
description: Deliberately declined; the closing comment records why

name: status/needs-triage
description: Awaiting type and priority; applied on arrival

name: status/blocked
description: Cannot proceed; the blocking issue or reason is linked in a comment

name: goal
description: A tracking issue carrying a long-horizon goal and its sub-issues

name: area/{{AREA_NAME}}
description: {{AREA_DESCRIPTION — derive one area label per real module or ownership boundary; keep in step with CODEOWNERS and labeler.yml}}
